{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "tankyleo",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "raised concerns about persisting sensitive broadcast tx data to disk on broadcaster-only nodes"
    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; notes benefits outweigh disk concerns, suggested 0600 file permissions and retention option"
    },
    {
      "login": "craigraw",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; suggested the approach doesn't go far enough and should consider a persistent broadcast pool"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3764729182",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "dumping sensitive transaction data to disk on broadcaster-only nodes expands the attack surface and privacy risk",
      "quote": "I have reservations about dumping sensitive data to disk on node shutdown. Previously a non-wallet, broadcaster-only node would not persist any sensitive data to disk, but with this PR it now does.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3764813472",
        "c:3773460735"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3799974990",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "unrestricted permissions on privatebroadcast.dat could leak sensitive private broadcast data",
      "quote": "Make sure the file gets permissions `0600`.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3809245705",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "a shutdown-dump approach does not solve transaction eviction from mempools or crashes, unlike a proper persistent broadcast pool",
      "quote": "However, I don't think this change goes far enough (or at least, should be considered a first step). Losing broadcasted transactions due to a node restart is probably quite rare.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3813166702"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3799974990",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "benefits of not losing transactions across restarts outweigh concerns about storing on disk",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3809245705",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "agrees with persisting broadcast transactions, though suggests a broader broadcast pool approach",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record for draft PR #34322. Tankyleo raised privacy/security concerns about writing broadcast records to disk on non-wallet nodes; Vasild provided Concept ACK with a reminder about 0600 permissions; Craigraw supported the concept but suggested a broader broadcast pool architecture, which the author agreed with as a better long-term design."
}
